description: relay_client.rs uses std::sync::Mutex (not tokio::sync::Mutex) for the MTA-STS cache. The guard is explicitly scoped to non-async blocks and dropped before any .await point, with a SAFETY comment explaining why. A contributor might suggest replacing it with tokio::sync::Mutex 'to be consistent with async'. That would be incorrect: tokio::sync::Mutex is for guards that need to be held across awaits; std::sync::Mutex is correct here, is lower overhead, and the scoping makes it safe. The SAFETY comments should be preserved.
title: std::sync::Mutex held only within non-async blocks around MtaStsEnforcer cache
